engine: kyber_ntt_engine_packed2 (EXTRA_STAGE=1), SRAM ntt_pair_sram 128 x 24 bit, single port
command: cd vectors && iverilog -g2012 -I . -DXSTAGE=1 -o acc.vvp ../rtl/kyber_pkg.sv ../rtl/barrett_reduce_1c.v ../rtl/kyber_ntt_engine_packed.sv ../rtl/kyber_ntt_engine_packed2.sv ../tb/tb_ntt_access_count.sv && vvp -n acc.vvp
method: posedge-clk count of u_sram ce&we (write) and ce&!we&busy (read) from the start pulse until done; coefficient load and read-back outside the window are not counted. Idle-port reads (ce with busy=0, external raddr read, 2 per transform) are reported separately and excluded.
